notes: Jeep J-series full-size pickup, 1972-1988 (the 1963-1971 Gladiator years are a separate job). Before 1974 the trucks were designated by wheelbase/GVW (J-2000/J-4000 series, 5000-8000 GVW); the J10 (lighter, 119/131 in. WB) and J20 (heavier, 131 in. WB, 6800-8400 GVW) names start in 1974. No engine was J20-only. The 258 six was never offered in the J20 (J10/light-GVW only), and the 1973 360 4-bbl was listed only for 5000-6000 GVW trucks. The J20 (and the 1972-73 7000/8000 GVW trucks) always had the 360 2-bbl standard. NHRA has no rows. Net hp is given only where factory tables state it (1972-73); later truck literature gives none. Mexican VAM trucks (J-364, 282 six) are excluded.
